title: DexKomik
description: Your manga and comic reading portal with a fast reader, scraping pipeline, and a cleaner browsing flow for long reading sessions.
content:
## The Reading Experience
DexKomik provides a distraction-free environment for reading manga and comics with fast navigation, clean chapter pages, and a responsive reader.

### Technical Challenges
The main challenge was building a robust scraping engine that can parse content quickly while keeping the interface smooth. Server-side caching and optimized parsing help keep browsing fast.

title: DexAnime
description: An anime streaming-style web app with cinematic UI, discovery pages, smooth transitions, and a large content browsing experience.
content:
## Streaming Next-Gen
DexAnime brings a cinematic anime browsing experience to the web.

### UI/UX Design
The interface is designed to feel immersive, with dark surfaces, motion-driven transitions, and a content-first layout for exploring shows quickly.

title: DexFilm
description: A movie discovery and watchlist experience for browsing films, checking details, and keeping entertainment picks organized.
content:
## Overview
DexFilm is the movie-side sibling of the Dex entertainment projects. It is shaped around discovery, detail pages, and a simple flow for finding what to watch next.

### Planned Features
- **Movie discovery**: browse trending, popular, and genre-based films.
- **Detail pages**: cast, synopsis, rating, and related titles.
- **Watchlist flow**: keep favorite films organized for later.

title: DexPDF
description: A privacy-friendly PDF management tool for organizing, converting, merging, splitting, and editing PDF documents in the browser.
content:
## Overview
DexPDF is a browser-based PDF utility for handling documents locally and quickly.

### Key Features
- **Client-side processing**: file operations can happen in the browser.
- **Merge and split**: combine files or extract pages.
- **Image to PDF**: turn images into shareable documents.

title: DexFileManager
description: A file management utility for organizing uploads, browsing assets, and building a cleaner file workflow.
content:
## Overview
DexFileManager is a utility project for making file workflows easier to browse, organize, and maintain.

### Focus Areas
- **Asset organization**: cleaner file listing and metadata surfaces.
- **Upload workflows**: predictable file handling flows.
- **Utility-first UI**: dense, practical interfaces for repeated use.

title: DexAutoEDA
description: An automated exploratory data analysis tool for turning raw datasets into useful summaries, visuals, and early insights.
content:
## Overview
DexAutoEDA helps speed up the early stage of data exploration by generating summaries, charts, and useful signals from datasets.

### Focus Areas
- **Dataset profiling**: surface missing values, types, distributions, and correlations.
- **Automatic charts**: generate starter visuals for quick analysis.
- **Insight workflow**: reduce setup time before deeper modeling or reporting.

title: DexKasir
description: A POS utility for managing inventory, sales, cashier workflows, and employee shifts.
content:
## Overview
DexKasir is a point-of-sale project focused on practical store operations.

### Core Ideas
- **Sales flow**: transaction handling for cashier workflows.
- **Inventory**: item, stock, and catalog management.
- **Operations**: employee shifts and daily reporting.

title: Laper.in
description: A campus food ordering app for the ITS area, connecting students with nearby canteens and student couriers who can pick up delivery orders.
content:
## Overview
Laper.in brings ITS canteens into one ordering flow, helping students discover nearby food, reorder favorites, and manage campus meals from a mobile-first web app.

### Core Features
- **Campus ordering**: browse food around ITS, search menus, and place orders from canteen listings.
- **Student courier flow**: students can become couriers, go online, and claim available delivery orders.
- **Order experience**: LaperPay points, order history, pre-order flow, and tracking keep the food journey easier to follow.

### Product Direction
The app is shaped for the rhythm of campus life: fast lunch decisions, affordable menu discovery, and a delivery network that can be powered by students themselves.

title: DexScrapper
description: A high-performance scraping engine for collecting web data, automating extraction, and preparing content pipelines.
content:
## Overview
DexScrapper is a data extraction utility for scraping, parsing, and preparing web data.

### Focus Areas
- **Automation**: repeatable scraping workflows.
- **Parsing**: extract useful fields from messy pages.
- **API layer**: expose scraping jobs through service endpoints.
